Title: Senior Data Scientist
Company: Sodimac
Location: Santiago, Chile (Hybrid)
Seniority: senior

About the role:
We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead customer analytics and
experimentation for our retail marketplace. You will build machine learning
models, design A/B tests, and partner with product and commercial teams.

Requirements:
- Strong Python and SQL
- Experience with Machine Learning (XGBoost, scikit-learn)
- Causal Inference or uplift modeling
- Experimentation / A/B Testing
- Comfortable with GCP or BigQuery
- Retail or marketplace domain preferred
- English proficiency for global stakeholders

Nice to have:
- MLOps and APIs
- Bayesian methods
